formal_statement:
∀ (q N : ℕ) (L : Fin N → Finset (Fin N)) (i0 p0 p1 : Fin N),
    3 ≤ q → N = q ^ 2 + q + 1 → (∀ i : Fin N, (L i).card = q + 1) → (∀ i j : Fin N, i ≠ j → (L i ∩ L j).card = 1) →
    (∀ p p' : Fin N, p ≠ p' → ∃ i : Fin N, p ∈ L i ∧ p' ∈ L i) →
    p0 ≠ p1 → p0 ∈ L i0 → p1 ∈ L i0 →
    (∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (o : Fin N → ℕ),
      (∀ gt ∈ gates, (gt.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ gt.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ gt.inputs.length ≤ 2) →
      (∀ (i : Fin gates.length), ∀ w ∈ (gates.get i).inputs, w < N + (i : ℕ)) →
      (∀ (t : Fin N) (x : Fin N → Bool), (x p0 = true ∨ x p1 = true ∨ ∀ u : Fin N, u ∉ L i0 → x u = true) →
        PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, o t⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ L t, x v = true)) →
      N * q ≤ gates.length) ∧
    ∃ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (o : Fin N → ℕ),
      (∀ gt ∈ gates, (gt.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ gt.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ gt.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin gates.length), ∀ w ∈ (gates.get i).inputs, w < N + (i : ℕ)) ∧
      (∀ (t : Fin N) (x : Fin N → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, o t⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ L t, x v = true)) ∧
      gates.length = N * q
plain_statement: Plane of order q >= 3, N = q^2+q+1 points, lines L_t; points 0 != 1 on line M0. AND/OR lists of fan-in at most two (constants allowed), each gate reading only earlier wires, whose N outputs equal the OR over L_t on every input true at 0, at 1, or everywhere off M0, for each of the N lines, have at least N q gates; and some such list of exactly N q gates has outputs equal to the line-ORs on every input.
title: AND/OR lists of fan-in at most two, plane of order q >= 3: line-ORs right on inputs true at 0, at 1 or off M0 need at least N q gates, and N q suffice
